onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: Handy needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: Dictation shortcut
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Hold to speak
transcribe.description: F8 by default. Hold to record and release to recognize with your selected cleanup mode. Click to change.

cancel.name: Cancel dictation
cancel.description: Esc by default. Cancel the current recording or processing without inserting text.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

copy_latest_result.name: Copy latest result
copy_latest_result.description: Ctrl+Shift+F8 by default. Copies an existing result without recognizing, cleaning, or pasting again.

toggle_cloud.name: Pause / resume cloud cleanup
toggle_cloud.description: Ctrl+Alt+F8 by default. Skip cloud cleanup while keeping local recognition. Click to change.

paste_latest_result.name: Paste latest result
paste_latest_result.description: Ctrl+Shift+F9 by default. Focus the input, press and release to paste the latest final text. Preserves the clipboard, without recognition, cleanup or sending.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Shortcut Behavior
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Handy

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Handy when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Handy icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Handy

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

muteWhileRecording.label: Mute playback while recording
muteWhileRecording.description: Temporarily mute the default playback device and restore its previous state when recording ends or is cancelled. Device changes or force quitting may affect restoration.

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Handy. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Handy normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Handy updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Handy stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Handy's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Handy needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Automatic insertion did not finish. Copy the retained text from the latest result or history.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Handy interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether Handy follows your system theme or stays light or dark

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

dictation.tagline: Local recognition · Hold to speak · Release to insert
dictation.sidebarNote:
Audio stays on this computer.
You decide when to send.
dictation.retention: Audio stays on this computer and expires after seven days. Text history also uses a seven-day default and can be deleted at any time.
dictation.initializationFailed: Shortcuts could not initialize. Please reopen the app.
dictation.recordingFailed: Recording could not start. Check your microphone and permissions.
dictation.transcriptionFailed: Recognition did not finish. Check the model or microphone and try again.
dictation.muteFailed: Playback muting or restoration did not finish. Check the system playback volume.

status.shortcutHint: Hold {{shortcut}} to speak, release to process; {{cancel}} cancels.
status.currentCursor: Text will be inserted at the current cursor when processing finishes. You decide when to send it.
status.fallback: Text cleanup did not finish. The original transcript is available in the latest result.

model.title: Local speech recognition
model.name: SenseVoice INT8
model.description: Local CPU recognition · Chinese and English
model.actionFailed: The model operation did not finish. Check the model files or connection and retry.
model.unavailable: SenseVoice model information is unavailable. Please reopen the app.
model.notBenchmarked: This client has not passed performance acceptance on this computer. Earlier validation tool measurements do not represent this version.

cleanup.title: Text cleanup
cleanup.description: Conservatively tidy punctuation and clear errors, preserving language, numbers, negation, paths, and arguments.

hints.claude: Uses Claude Haiku 5.5. Only transcript text is sent; audio is not uploaded.
hints.local: Connects to a compatible service on this computer. Failures keep the original text and do not switch to the cloud.
hints.off: Uses the original local transcript directly.

cleanup.fallback: Slow or failed cleanup uses the complete local transcript with confirmed vocabulary.
cleanup.saveFailed: Settings were not saved. Check the local address and model name, then retry.
cleanup.loadFailed: Cleanup settings could not be read.
cleanup.keyPlaceholder: Enter a new key (never shown after saving)
cleanup.keyMissing: No Claude key configured. The original transcript will be used.
cleanup.keySaved: Key saved in Windows secure storage
cleanup.keyFailed: The key operation did not finish. Please retry.
cleanup.localModelPlaceholder: Model name from your local service

strengthHints.faithful: Fix punctuation and clear errors while preserving your phrasing.
strengthHints.light: Remove empty fillers and repetitions, with conservative sentence cleanup.
strengthHints.clear: Improve local sentence order and clarity while keeping your meaning and tone.

cleanup.paragraphsHint: Separate related ideas into paragraphs. A pause alone does not create a paragraph.
cleanup.fidelity: Every level preserves facts, numbers, code, negation, conditions, and uncertainty. No added facts, answers, or summaries.

history.title: History
history.empty: Your result and original transcript will appear here after dictation.
history.inputAttempt: Insertion was attempted. Copy the result if no text appeared.
history.originalUsed: The original transcript was kept for this entry.
history.copyLatestFailed: The latest result could not be copied. Check that a result exists or retry from history.

vocabulary.title: Manual vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Add known names, products, and technical terms yourself. Learned vocabulary below is kept separately.
vocabulary.learningDescription: Review recurring terms and suggestions from correction samples before they take effect.
vocabulary.localOnly: Candidates and correction samples are analyzed on this computer. Confirmed terms can help local fallback too.
vocabulary.confirmHint: Review spelling and context. A frequent transcript term can still be wrong; suggestions never apply before confirmation.
vocabulary.learnedHint: Confirmed terms remain after source history expires. Edit or disable them here; disabled terms are excluded from local correction and cloud hints.
vocabulary.loadFailed: Vocabulary could not be read. Please refresh.
vocabulary.changeFailed: Vocabulary could not be changed. Please refresh and retry.
vocabulary.editHint: Term: up to 64 characters, or 40 with aliases. Up to 20 aliases, 24 characters each. Context: 2–24 characters in the same clause; Chinese aliases require context. Clear aliases to stop replacing those aliases.
vocabulary.recentCorrectionsHint: Only actual local replacements from this dictation are shown. Starting another dictation clears them; closing the app discards them. Related cloud hint terms are not correction hits.
vocabulary.noRecentCorrections: No local correction hits for the current dictation.

errors.vocabulary_term_invalid: Enter a term of 1–64 characters using letters, numbers, spaces, or _./+-#.
errors.vocabulary_context_invalid: Context must be 2–24 characters using letters, numbers, spaces, or _+-, without punctuation or line breaks.
errors.vocabulary_alias_invalid: Each alias must be a safe technical correction of up to 24 characters. Chinese aliases require context; numbers, negations and common words cannot be replaced.
errors.vocabulary_alias_duplicate: Remove duplicate aliases (letter case is ignored).
errors.vocabulary_alias_limit: Use at most 20 aliases per term.
errors.vocabulary_term_duplicate: This term and context already exist. Edit the existing entry.
errors.vocabulary_alias_ambiguous: This term or alias conflicts with another learned entry, including disabled entries. Change the conflicting source or remove the other entry.

dictation.settingsFailed: App settings could not be read.

states.nextRecording: Cooldown finished · retry on the next recording

cloud.hint: Pause skips pending cloud cleanup and keeps local transcription. Resume applies to the next recording; local model mode is unaffected.
cloud.loadFailed: Cloud status could not be read.
cloud.changeFailed: Cloud status could not be changed. Please retry.
cloud.policy: Short text gets a 3-second cloud budget, with up to 8 seconds for longer text. Three consecutive timeouts or network failures pause cloud cleanup for 10 minutes.

timing.title: Latest processing time
timing.note: Measured from recording release to software completion; this does not measure when text becomes visible on screen. Times are local and contain no transcript text.
timing.empty: Processing times appear after your next dictation.
timing.loadFailed: Processing times could not be read.

outcomes.cloud_paused: Cloud manually paused; local transcript used
outcomes.cloud_cooldown: Cloud cooling down; local transcript used
outcomes.cloud_paused_during_cleanup: Cloud paused while waiting; local transcript used
outcomes.cleanup_timeout: Cleanup timed out; local transcript used
outcomes.cleanup_http_error: Cloud service unavailable; local transcript used
outcomes.invalid_response: Cleanup failed validation; local transcript used
outcomes.unknown: Local transcript retained or processing incomplete
outcomes.cleanup_response_too_large: Cleanup response too large; local transcript used
outcomes.cleanup_storage_unavailable: Cleanup settings unavailable; local transcript used
outcomes.claude_key_unavailable: Cloud credentials unavailable; local transcript used
outcomes.missing_claude_api_key: Cloud credentials missing; local transcript used
outcomes.cloud_state_unavailable: Cloud state unavailable; local transcript used

timing.cleanupFallbackUnknown: Cleanup did not finish; local transcript retained
timing.summaryScope: Last 7 days · {{count}} retained records · up to 300. Fallback counts can overlap other results.
timing.smallSample: Fewer than 5 completed samples; these values are only an early reference.
timing.noCompletedSamples: No confirmed completed insertion samples yet. Cancelled, silent and incomplete attempts are excluded from median waits.
timing.resourceNote: Current Windows process only, read at processing boundaries after recording release. Memory is the largest sampled working set, not a true peak. CPU is process time during this interval, may include concurrent work, and is not whole-system usage. No continuous sampling.

correction.title: Provide a corrected sample
correction.description: Paste your revised version of this result. The app compares it locally and suggests terms or contextual corrections for your review.
correction.label: Your corrected text
correction.placeholder: Paste the complete corrected version for this record here…
correction.privacy: Only this text is submitted locally. No clipboard reading, cloud sample upload, or automatic insertion. The sample follows its text history retention.
correction.saved: Sample saved locally. Review pending vocabulary below. Large rewrites may produce no correction suggestions.
correction.failed: The sample could not be saved. Check that the record still exists, then retry.

startup.label: Start when signing in to Windows
startup.description: Runs independently of Codex and starts in the tray at sign-in. Closing settings keeps it running; use the tray menu to quit.
startup.failed: Could not confirm or change the login setting. Try again; it will not be shown as successfully enabled.

manualPaste.read_observed: Paste was requested. Please check the input field.
manualPaste.input_sent: Paste was requested, but insertion is unconfirmed. Check before repeating.
manualPaste.busy: Recording, processing or input is still active. Try again after it finishes.
manualPaste.no_result: There is no completed result to paste.
manualPaste.cancelled: Paste cancelled. Input already sent cannot be recalled.
manualPaste.keys_held: Keys are still held. No paste was made; release them and try again.
manualPaste.unavailable: Manual paste is unavailable. Results remain in history.
manualPaste.history_failed: Could not read the latest result. No paste was made.
manualPaste.unsupported: Protected manual paste is unavailable on this platform.
manualPaste.keyboard_unavailable: Could not confirm key release. No paste was made; return to the normal desktop and try again.
manualPaste.release_to_retry: Release all keys, then press the manual-paste shortcut again.
manualPaste.failed: Paste could not finish. Check the input field; the result remains in history.
manualPaste.binding_conflict: This combination conflicts with an existing shortcut, which was preserved. Change the manual-paste shortcut before using it.
manualPaste.bindingCheckFailed: Could not confirm the manual-paste shortcut status. Reopen settings to check.

errors.manual_paste_cancelled: Paste cancelled. Input already sent cannot be recalled.
errors.manual_paste_injection_failed: Input could not finish. Check the field; it will not be retried automatically.
errors.manual_paste_restore_failed: The original clipboard could not be fully restored. Check it; the result remains in history.
errors.manual_paste_backup_too_large: The clipboard exceeds the safe backup size. No paste was made.
errors.manual_paste_backup_failed: Could not safely save the clipboard. No paste was made.
errors.manual_paste_unsupported_format: The clipboard has a format that cannot be restored safely. No paste was made.
errors.manual_paste_clipboard_busy: The clipboard is busy. No paste was made; try again shortly.
errors.manual_paste_clipboard_changed: Newly copied content was preserved. Please check the input field.
errors.manual_paste_publish_failed: Could not prepare paste data. Check the input; no automatic retry.
errors.manual_paste_render_failed: Could not provide complete paste data. Check the input; no automatic retry.
errors.manual_paste_unavailable: Protected paste is unavailable. The result remains in history.
errors.manual_paste_invalid_text: No valid text is available to paste.
errors.manual_paste_unsupported_method: The configured input method does not support manual paste. The result remains available in history.
